name: edit_chart
description: Add, read or change a chart. add: a new chart, styled as Office inserts one. read: type, data, formats, scales, and what Edit Data holds. Others change data, titles, legend, labels, axes, colours, series type, text or gridlines; values and workbook change together. Batch several changes.

target.description: The chart; add: decks the slide, documents the paragraph to follow. Or $ref.

action.description: What to do; read changes nothing.

chart_type.description: add: the kind of chart; set_series_type: line or column.

data.description: add: each series' name and one value per category, null for a blank.

type.description: line: drawn as a line (column charts).

width.description: add, documents: width in pt. Default 432.

number_format.description: add: the values'; show_data_labels: the labels'. Excel code, e.g. #,##0.0.

values.description: One per category (set_values, add_series) or series (add_category), null for a blank; add: scatter, bubble x values.

value.description: set_value: the value; set_gap_width: % of a bar's width.

text.description: New name, label or title; add: the chart title.

axis.description: set_axis_title, set_axis_scale, set_gridlines; add with scale.

scale.description: set_axis_scale, add: the axis' scale; keys left out stay.

colors.description: add: series colours in order (pie: slices').

style.description: format_series, format_point: fill to marker_fill; set_text_style, add: font to color. Colours as shapes take them, or none.

part.description: set_text_style, add: only this text. Default all.

cells.description: set_point_labels: also in the workbook (Value From Cells).

secondary.description: set_series_type: on a second value axis.

position.description: set_legend, add: legend position, none hides it; set_point_labels: label position.

ref.description: add: ref name for the new chart.

from.description: add, set_values, add_series: rows of d:<id> or table t:<name>.

columns.description: from's category column, then series columns; default all.

date_format.description: add from: category dates' pattern, e.g. d mmmm yyyy.

blanks.description: How null values draw; span joins lines across. New charts: gap.
